description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the AboutOrganizationAPI within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on fetching organization info and ensuring that other methods throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AboutOrganizationAPI endpoints and behaviors, particularly the getOne method and unimplemented update, delete, and validation rule methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API call with different test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases data from 'AboutOrganizationTestCase.yaml' for parameterized testing of 'getOne'.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling update() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForUpdate() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForDelete() throws a not implemented exception.
